title: Crew Manifest
summary: Open the ship's real astronaut log and work out what one row is before counting anything.
hints: `unique()` keeps one copy of each value, so `length(unique(astronauts$number))` counts the people.
Each astronaut's first mission has `mission_number == 1`: `first_flights <- astronauts[astronauts$mission_number == 1, ]`, then `table(first_flights$sex)`.
